title: What Is Still There When I'm Eighty?
description:
What will still matter when I'm eighty?

Not what I accomplished. Not how productive I was. Maybe not even the person I spent so many years trying to become.

This is a reflection on growing older, identity, relationships, usefulness, and the quieter question underneath them all: when the roles begin to fall away, what remains?

Maybe the point isn't to arrive at eighty with everything figured out. Maybe it's to become someone I can still recognize — and someone who still has something to give.

A SECOND LOOK AT LIFE
Essays about time, work, relationships, aging, and the lives we are quietly building.
